skill_name: Write a description of a computer programmer in 200 words.
workflow: A computer programmer is an important part of the programming industry, providing the knowledge and skill necessary to build and enhance software applications, systems and websites. Computer programmers are responsible for writing, testing and modifying code according to industry standards, in order to make an application or system run as desired.
